title: Nike Sportswear Classic Puffer — Women's Therma-FIT Parka

quilting.source_detail: The user's own photos (data/reference-photos, agent L1b): Parka1 (worn front), Parka2 (worn back), Parka3/Parka6 (flat front/back) show horizontal channels running from the zip to the side panel seams, with no vertical stitch lines; replaces the earlier retailer-photo 'box' estimate. chamber_width is kept but unused for horizontal quilting.

chamber_height.source_detail: The user's flat-lay photos with a US Letter sheet (21.59 x 27.94 cm) as a ruler (agent L2; lead's reference-spec update 2026-11-12 night): parka-a4-1 (front) stitch lines 350-410 px apart at 36.6 px/cm (9.6-11.2 cm), parka-a4-3 (back) ~380 px at 36.4-37.6 px/cm (10.1-10.4 cm); lead's reading 9.5-10 cm. Replaces 15 cm, which came from an assumed px->cm scale on the worn photos. Approximate, not garment tape.

chamber_width.source_detail: User-approved prompts/03-realism.md Part B; Claude's photo estimates scaled by owned HPS length. Approximate, not garment tape; user may override.

yoke_depth.source_detail: Agent L3 (lead-approved): the user's worn-back photo Parka2 has its first stitch line ~90 px below HPS; at the 0.055 cm/px implied by the 10 cm channel pitch (US Letter flat-lays) that is ~5 cm, and the user's video back view (t 36 s, sleeve and body channels ~125 px = 10 cm) gives ~5 cm at the shoulders. The Letter sheets do not show the yoke. Replaces L2's unmeasured 7.5 cm. Approximate, not garment tape; user may override.

colour_hex.source_detail: Optic white with a faint cool cast (agent L1a, best effort before the A4-paper photos). Hue from the user's photos, uncalibrated: raw Parka3/4/6 cloth reads a* +1.3..+2.2, b* -2.3..-5.8 and the window-frame-balanced Parka1/2 read (+2.5, -3.8) and (-0.3, +2.4) (docs/look/colour-measurements.md, LOW reliability); chroma kept at a fraction of that. Lightness L* 94.5 is an assumption for bright white polyester (not measured). Lab (94.5, 0.6, -2.2). Replace with the paper-calibrated value when the A4 photos arrive.
